aspects.name: Aspect of Combustion
aspects.kit_changes: Your Basic Attacks now ignite enemies dealing damage over time and stacking 5 times. Flame Wave and Rain of Fire consume ignites dealing a burst of damage. Rain of Fire deals reduced damage.

aspects.name: Aspect of Strife
aspects.kit_changes: Your Basic Attacks are now melee and deal increased damage, cleave, and apply stronger Shifter of Seasons effects to all enemies hit. In addition, Horn Charge's cooldown is reduced when hitting a god or Jungle Monster and applies Shifter of Seasons.

aspects.name: Aspect of the Heroic Tutor
aspects.kit_changes: Target Mark now only applies to one target, and you passively copy 10% of damage done to that target, dealing it again as Physical Damage. Target Mark can no longer apply to lane minions. Training Exercise boosts Allies' Strength and Intelligence when it hits or cleanses them. Centaurus has less scaling, but slows enemies, and when it hits allies, grants them Attack Speed, Shield and applies Herbal Medicine's buff.

aspects.name: Aspect of Relativity
aspects.kit_changes: Time Lord no longer grants Intelligence but instead creates a persistent Time Field arond you. Allies in your Time Field gain bonuses when you use your other abilities.

aspects.name: Aspect of Preservation
aspects.kit_changes: Mitigate Wounds no longer Heals based on damage or provides Attack Speed. Instead Hercules gains a Stack when he or nearby allied gods take damage from Basic Attacks and when the ability ends, stacks are expended to Heal nearby allied gods.

aspects.name: Aspect of the Cursed Crown
aspects.kit_changes: Your Attacks are now melee. You gain Wrath over time and when you deal damage. Consuming Power has two levels that can be used at 40 and 80 Wrath. Sigil Mastery fires all 3 Sigils simultaneously. Shroud of Wildfire Attack explosions deal a percentage of your Max Health as damage.

aspects.name: Aspect of Thermotherapy
aspects.kit_changes: Solar Blessing and Searing Pain only deal base damage with no scaling. In return, Solar Blessing can be placed on allied gods, attaching to them and Searing Pain Heals allied hits.

items.name: Blinking Abyss
items.passive: Adaptive Stat: +20 Strength or +35 Intelligence (based on highest item stat). +5% of all Stats from Items. On Use: Teleport up to 5.6m. Can be used in combat, but not while firing an ability. 1s after Teleport: Deal 25 (+10% Strength & Intelligence) Magical Damage in a 3.2m radius. If this damages a god, reduce cooldown by -65s. Cooldown: 200s

items.name: Book of Thoth
items.passive: +Intelligence equal to 5% of Mana from Items. Deal 900 Damage to Minions or Jungle Monsters: +1 Evolve Stack +1 Mana Infusion Stack (Max 50 Stacks) Damage dealt to Gods counts double Per Mana Infusion Stack: +10 Mana. At 50 Evolve Stacks, Item evolves and gains: Additional +Intelligence equal to 2% of Mana from Items +5 Penetration +100 Mana

items.name: Chronos' Pendant
items.passive: Every 10s: -1s Ability Cooldowns.

items.name: Deathbringer
items.passive: +35% Critical Strike Damage.

items.name: Devourer's Gauntlet
items.passive: Kill Minion or Jungle Monsters: +1 Stack. Each Stack grants: +.4 Strength +0.05% Lifesteal At 75 Stacks, gain: +10 Strength +3% Lifesteal Continue to stack more Slowly; 10 Minion Kills: +1 Stack, Jungle Boss Kill or Assist: +4 Stacks

items.name: Dwarven Plate
items.passive: +15 Physical Protections +45 Magical Protections

items.name: Gem of Isolation
items.passive: Damaging Ability Hit: 15% Slow. The Slow lasts for 2s.

items.name: Genji's Guard
items.passive: Hit by Magical Ability Damage: -3s Cooldowns. Cooldown: 15s

items.name: Hastened Fatalis
items.passive: Attack Hits a God: -12.5% Attack Movement Penalty. Melee hits grants 2 Stacks. Stacks up to 4 times. Buff lasts 2s.

items.name: Heartseeker
items.passive: Ability Hit: +%Health Physical Damage. Damage = 2% of your Strength, as a % of the target's Max Health.

items.name: Hydra's Lament
items.passive: Ability Used: Bonus Damage on your next successful Attack. +30% for Melee or +20% for Ranged Buff lasts 8s.

items.name: Jotunn's Revenge
items.passive: God Kill or Assist: -1s Cooldown for Non-Ultimate Abilities -5s Cooldown for Ultimate Abilities

items.name: Magi's Cloak
items.passive: Every 90s: Gain a Hard Crowd Control protective bubble. When triggered, gain Crowd Control Immunity for 1.5s.

items.name: Nimble Ring
items.passive: For every 10 Intelligence: +1 Attack Damage +1% Attack Speed

items.name: Odysseus' Bow
items.passive: Every fourth Attack Hit: Trigger Chain Lightning. Damage = 15 (+60% Attack Damage) Physical Damage Hits target and up to 4 nearby enemies Bounce Range: 4.8m Can hit the same target more than once

items.name: Rage
items.passive: God Kill or Assist: +4% Critical Strike Chance (Max 20%) After 5 God Kills or Assists: +10% additional Critical Strike Chance

items.name: Riptalon
items.passive: While Above 50% Health: +10% Attack Damage While Below 50% Health: +25% Attack Damage +7.5% Lifesteal

items.name: Rod of Tahuti
items.passive: +Intelligence equal to 25% of your Intelligence from items.

items.name: Shifter's Shield
items.passive: Over 75% Health:+45 Strength or +55 Intelligence (whichever is higher). Under 75% Health: +20 Physical and Magical Protection.

items.name: Soul Gem
items.passive: Ability Hit: +1 Stack. Three Stacks: Next Ability Hit: Deals Bonus Damage (40% Intelligence) +20(+6 per Level) Heal you and allies within 3.2m Removes the Stacks

items.name: Spear of Desolation
items.passive: God Kill: -3s Non Ultimate Cooldowns -10s Ultimate Cooldowns God Assist: -1.5s Non Ultimate Cooldowns -5s Ultimate Cooldowns

items.name: The Crusher
items.passive: Ability Hit: +Physical Damage. Damage = 35% of your Strength Damage is dealt over 1s Subsequent hits on the same target deal 33% bonus Damage, over 3s.

items.name: The Reaper
items.passive: Kill a God: Heal +15% of Slain God's Max Health Assist a God: Heal +7.5% of Slain God's Max Health During Moonlight Phase: Heal +15% of Slain God's Max Health, on Kill or Assist

items.name: The World Stone
items.passive: -30% Cooldown for your Ultimate Ability.

items.name: Transcendence
items.passive: +Strength equal to 3% of Mana from Items. Deal 700 Damage to Minions or Jungle Monsters: +1 Evolve Stack +1 Mana Infusion Stack (Max 50 Stacks) Damage dealt to Gods counts double Per Mana Infusion Stack: +10 Mana. At 50 Evolve Stacks, item evolves and gains: +10 Penetration +100 Mana
